# Writing Plans Skill

This skill teaches how to author clear, detailed, and execution-ready plans for the `gin-workflow` plugin.

## Execution Rules

1. Always follow the format defined in [plan-schema.md](file://plan-schema.md) when writing or modifying a plan.
2. Save plans in the `.planning/plans/` directory with a timestamped or semantic filename (e.g. `.planning/plans/2026-06-28-init-auth.md`).
3. Ensure tasks are broken down into discrete tracks that can run independently or specify dependencies explicitly.
4. Define a clear, testable acceptance criteria for each track.
5. Document verification steps in the `Validation` section.
